item: Articles kept compressed get their dates, places and people, and the junk screen judges them
key_paths: src/timemap/text.py; src/timemap/datestore.py; src/timemap/whostore.py; src/analytics/store.py; src/analytics/reindex_parallel.py; src/backup/merge.py; src/analytics/quarantine_job.py; src/analytics/criteria_calibration.py; tests/test_compressed_articles_are_read.py
summary: An article kept compressed holds its text in compressed_content and leaves content empty. The date, place and entity stores and the quarantine screen read content directly, so such an article never got a date, a place or a person on any path and was never screened; the keyword half read get_content() and was fine. All of them now read the decompressed text (src.timemap.text.article_text, Article.get_content's rule); the precompute's fifth context slot, which handed the pool the empty column so its rows matched, is gone; the stamp and carry digests hash the same text (unchanged for an uncompressed article). Quarantine criteria nav-soup-v3. Rides #2031's INDEXER 4 / WWW 2 step; held until the user's mass import ends.
